intent.responsibility: Own one complete one-to-one or group video-call Screen.
intent.visualBoundary: Own system chrome, optional header, participant layout, optional self view and optional call controls.
intent.runtimeBehavior: Runtime owns call title, layout mode, self participant identity, control states and an ordered participant collection.
intent.forwarding: Forward each participant collection item explicitly to the fixed Call Participant Variant and each control to its fixed Button Variant.
intent.temporalOwnership: The Screen owns participant presence; every participant Runtime field is resolved relative to that participant first appearance.
intent.productionContext: Use exact Screen → Shot → Actor → Theme/Device context.
